title: Precision Rubber Rollers & Custom Roller Assemblies
subtitle: Custom Compounds. Precision Manufacturing. Made in the USA.
intro: SYNC Manufacturing produces engineered rubber-covered rollers and custom roller assemblies for OEMs requiring precision, specialized elastomer materials, and dependable manufacturing support.

Through our Carson City, Nevada operation, we combine in-house rubber compounding, metal core and shaft manufacturing, rubber-to-metal bonding, precision grinding, and finishing to produce rollers tailored to demanding industrial applications.

From new roller development and production manufacturing to refurbishment and replacement, our team works with engineers and equipment manufacturers to deliver solutions built around their specific requirements.

blocks.text: Engineered from the core to the finished assembly.

Roller performance depends on more than the rubber covering. Material selection, core geometry, bond integrity, dimensional accuracy, and surface finish all influence how a roller performs in its intended application.
Our manufacturing experience includes:
Our integrated manufacturing capabilities allow us to support the process from compound selection and metal core manufacturing through finished roller production.
Selecting the right rubber compound for the application.
Different operating environments demand different elastomer properties.
Factors such as temperature, chemical exposure, abrasion, traction, hardness, and compression behavior can influence material selection and roller service life.
Our manufacturing experience includes specialty roller applications using materials such as:
HNBR — Hydrogenated Nitrile Rubber
Considered for applications requiring resistance to wear, oils, elevated temperatures, and demanding mechanical conditions.
Fluorosilicone Rubber
Considered for specialized applications involving temperature exposure and certain fuels, oils, or chemical environments.
Silicone Rubber
Used in applications requiring flexibility and temperature performance, including certain precision handling and processing systems.
Other Engineered Elastomers
Additional rubber compounds and formulations may be evaluated based on performance requirements, geometry and manufacturing feasibility.
Material recommendations are application-specific and subject to technical review.
Film Processing and Flexible Packaging
Precision rubber rollers play a critical role in film handling, web tension, material transport, coating and laminating operations.
Potential products include nip rollers, tension rollers, feed rollers, pressure rollers and specialized web-handling assemblies.
Printing, Labeling and Converting Equipment
Rollers influence material movement, contact pressure, registration and repeatability in printing and labeling systems.
We support custom roller geometries, elastomer selection and precision manufacturing requirements for specialized equipment.
Industrial Machinery and Automation
Custom rubber-covered rollers are used to feed, transport, position and process materials in automated manufacturing systems.
Our capabilities support OEMs requiring application-specific roller dimensions, shaft configurations, surface properties and materials.
Specialty Coating and Advanced Materials
Specialized roller compounds and geometries can support demanding coating, film processing and advanced-material manufacturing processes.
Applications are evaluated based on operating conditions, precision requirements and material compatibility.
Integrated manufacturing capabilities under one roof.
Our Carson City operation combines specialized rubber manufacturing with metalworking and secondary processing capabilities.
Services include:
This integrated approach helps simplify supplier coordination and supports consistent manufacturing from initial development through repeat production.

sections.heading: New Rollers, Replacement Parts and Refurbishment

blocks.text: Whether you're developing new machinery, sourcing production rollers, or evaluating a replacement for an existing component, our team can review your requirements.
We support OEM production requirements and custom replacement roller applications, including refurbishment of eligible existing roller assemblies.
Our engineering and production teams evaluate roller geometry, material specifications, operating conditions, and volume requirements to determine the appropriate manufacturing approach.
Experienced rubber manufacturing
Our Carson City operation traces its rubber manufacturing experience to 1948, including precision rubber-covered rollers and specialty industrial products.
Integrated technical capabilities
In-house compounding, metalworking, bonding, grinding and assembly provide a coordinated approach to custom roller production.
U.S.-based manufacturing
Our Carson City, Nevada facility provides domestic manufacturing and engineering support for equipment manufacturers across the United States.
Responsive customer collaboration
We work directly with customers to evaluate drawings, discuss material requirements, address manufacturing challenges and support new production programs.

closing.heading: Let's Review Your Roller Application
paragraphs: Developing a new roller? Looking for a manufacturing partner? Need a replacement for an existing custom roller?
Send our team your requirements, including available drawings, roller dimensions, material specifications, operating conditions and estimated annual quantities.
